mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% triggers a Fed response that lowers interest rates, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a Fed emergency rate cut, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 620 and RSAFS < 380000.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% per annum triggers a Fed tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.

mechanism_narrative: The level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as a strong labor market supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 13000), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 380000 and GDPC1 > 13000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a deepening economic contraction, triggering a Fed emergency response that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95 and GDPC1 < 13300.
